q_vocab_b2_02_007.question: A philosophy professor asks students to question whether reality is truly as we perceive it. Which concept is being discussed?
q_vocab_b2_02_007.explanation: 'El escepticismo' (skepticism) is the philosophical position that questions the possibility of certain knowledge. It challenges assumptions about perception และ reality.

q_vocab_b2_07_008.question: la xenofobia

q_vocab_b2_07_009.question: A community organization wants to help newly arrived immigrants integrate. Which initiative would be most effective?
q_vocab_b2_07_009.correct: Ofrecer programas de integración cultural y clases de idioma.

q_vocab_b2_07_009.explanation: 'Programas de integración cultural' แปลว่า 'cultural integration programs'. Helping immigrants learn the language และ understand local culture is key to successful integration.
q_vocab_b2_07_009.context: Community organization planning immigrant support services

q_vocab_b2_07_010.question: An NGO publishes a report about poverty in urban areas. Which term describes ผู้คน living below the minimum standard of living?

q_vocab_b2_07_010.explanation: 'Perลูกชายas en situación de pobreza extrema' แปลว่า 'ผู้คน in extreme poverty'. This สำหรับmal phrasing is used in reports และ policy documents to describe those living below subsisสิบce level.

q_vocab_b2_08_001.question: What does the idiom 'estar en las nubes' mean?
q_vocab_b2_08_001.correct: to be วันdreaming / to have หนึ่ง's head in the clouds
q_vocab_b2_08_001.explanation: 'Estar en las nubes' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to be in the clouds' และ idiomatically แปลว่า to be วันdreaming หรือ not paying atสิบtion.

q_vocab_b2_08_002.question: No entiendo nada de física cuántica; para mí es ___ con siete sellos.
q_vocab_b2_08_002.explanation: 'Ser un libro con siete sellos' แปลว่า 'to be a closed หนังสือ' หรือ something incomprehensible. The อิ่ม idiom แปลว่า 'The topic is a complete mystery to me.'

q_vocab_b2_08_003.question: What does 'meter la pata' mean?
q_vocab_b2_08_003.correct: to put หนึ่ง's foot in it / to make a blunder
wrong: to put หนึ่ง's leg in a hole
to step on an animal's paw
q_vocab_b2_08_003.explanation: 'Meter la pata' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to put the paw in' และ idiomatically แปลว่า to make a mistake หรือ blunder, especially by saying something inappropriate.

q_vocab_b2_08_004.question: What does 'tomar el pelo a alguien' mean?
q_vocab_b2_08_004.correct: to pull someหนึ่ง's leg / to ชาse someหนึ่ง
wrong: to cut someหนึ่ง's hair
to grab someหนึ่ง's hair
to style someหนึ่ง's hair
q_vocab_b2_08_004.explanation: 'Tomar el pelo a alguien' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to take someหนึ่ง's hair' but idiomatically แปลว่า to ชาse หรือ make fun of someหนึ่ง, similar to 'pulling someหนึ่ง's leg'.

q_vocab_b2_08_005.question: to cost an arm และ a leg (to be very แพง)
q_vocab_b2_08_005.correct: costar un ojo de la cara
wrong: costar un brazo y una pierna
costar una ผู้ชายo y un pie
q_vocab_b2_08_005.explanation: 'Costar un ojo de la รถยนต์a' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to cost an eye from the face' และ is the Spanish equivalent of 'to cost an arm และ a leg'. Each language has its own body-part metaphor สำหรับ high cost.

q_vocab_b2_08_006.question: What does 'no tener pelos en la lengua' mean?
q_vocab_b2_08_006.correct: to be outspoken / to not mince words
q_vocab_b2_08_006.explanation: 'No สิบer pelos en la lengua' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to not have hairs on the tongue' และ แปลว่า to speak frankly และ directly without hเก่า/แก่ing back.

q_vocab_b2_08_007.question: Your เพื่อน just tเก่า/แก่ you they won the lottery, but you suspect they are joking. Which idiom would you use?
q_vocab_b2_08_007.explanation: '¡Me estás toผู้ชายdo el pelo!' แปลว่า 'You're pulling my leg!' หรือ 'You're kidding me!' It expresses disbelief at what seems like a joke.
q_vocab_b2_08_007.context: Casual conversation with a เพื่อน who shares surprising ใหม่s

q_vocab_b2_08_008.question: What does 'dar en el clavo' mean?
q_vocab_b2_08_008.correct: to hit the nail on the head / to get it exactly ถูกต้อง/ขวา
wrong: to hammer a nail into wood
q_vocab_b2_08_008.explanation: 'Dar en el clavo' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to hit the nail' และ idiomatically แปลว่า to get something exactly ถูกต้อง/ขวา, เหมือนกับ the English 'to hit the nail on the head'.

q_vocab_b2_08_009.question: echar leña al fuego
q_vocab_b2_08_009.correct: to add fuel to the fire / to make things worse

q_vocab_b2_08_009.explanation: 'Echar leña al fuego' แปลตามตัวว่า 'to throw wood on the fire' และ idiomatically แปลว่า to make a แย่ situation worse, equivalent to 'adding fuel to the fire'.

q_vocab_b2_08_010.question: สอง coworkers are gossiping about a colleague's mistake. A third coworker arrives และ says something that makes the situation more tense. Which idiom describes what the third คน did?
q_vocab_b2_08_010.correct: Echó leña al fuego con su comentario.

Estuvo en las nubes durante la conversación.
Tomó el pelo a sus compañeros.
q_vocab_b2_08_010.explanation: 'Echar leña al fuego' แปลว่า 'to add fuel to the fire'. The third coworker's comment made the already สิบse gossip situation even worse.
q_vocab_b2_08_010.context: Workplace conflict escalated by an ill-timed comment

q_vocab_b2_09_001.question: What does 'la tesis' mean in an academic context?
q_vocab_b2_09_001.explanation: 'La tesis' แปลว่า 'thesis' หรือ 'dissertation', a substantial academic work submitted สำหรับ a degree, presenting the author's research และ findings.

q_vocab_b2_09_002.question: What does 'la hipótesis' mean?
q_vocab_b2_09_002.explanation: 'La hipótesis' แปลว่า 'hypothesis', a proposed explanation สำหรับ a phenomenon that can be tested through research และ experimentation.

q_vocab_b2_09_003.question: El investigador describió la ___ utilizada para recopilar los datos.
q_vocab_b2_09_003.explanation: 'Metodología' แปลว่า 'methodology'. The senสิบce แปลว่า 'The researcher described the methodology used to collect the data.' Methodology explains how research is conducted.

q_vocab_b2_09_004.question: What does 'la cita bibliográfica' mean?
wrong: a roผู้ชายtic date at a library
q_vocab_b2_09_004.explanation: 'La cita bibliográfica' แปลว่า 'bibliographic citation', a reference to a source used in academic เขียน. 'Cita' แปลว่า both 'citation' และ 'appointment/date'.

q_vocab_b2_09_005.question: What does 'el marco teórico' mean in a research paper?
q_vocab_b2_09_005.explanation: 'El marco teórico' แปลว่า 'theoretical framework', the structure of concepts และ theories that supports และ inสำหรับms academic research.

q_vocab_b2_09_006.question: peer review
q_vocab_b2_09_006.explanation: 'Peer review' translates to 'la revisión por pares'. 'Pares' แปลว่า 'peers' (equals). Don't confuse with 'padres' (พ่อแม่), 'partes' (parts), หรือ 'parejas' (couples).

q_vocab_b2_09_007.question: Which Spanish term แปลว่า 'abstract' as in the summary at the beginning of an academic paper?
q_vocab_b2_09_007.explanation: 'El resumen' (หรือ borrowed 'el abstract') is the brief summary at the beginning of an academic paper. 'Lo abstracto' แปลว่า 'the abstract' as in abstract art/concepts.

q_vocab_b2_09_008.question: las conclusiones del estudio
q_vocab_b2_09_008.explanation: 'Las conclusiหนึ่งs del estudio' แปลว่า 'the conclusions of the study', the final section of a research paper where findings are summarized และ interpreted.

q_vocab_b2_09_009.question: A professor asks a นักเรียน to avoid plagiarism in their research paper. What must the นักเรียน do?
q_vocab_b2_09_009.correct: Citar correctamente todas las fuentes utilizadas.
wrong: Copiar textos sin indicar la fuente.
Escribir solo opiniones personales sin investigar.
Entregar el trabajo de otro estudiante.
q_vocab_b2_09_009.explanation: 'Citar correctamente todas las fuentes' แปลว่า 'to correctly cite all sources used'. Proper citation is essential to avoid 'el plagio' (plagiarism) in academic work.
q_vocab_b2_09_009.context: University research เขียน course

q_vocab_b2_09_010.question: A researcher needs to describe how they collected data from 500 participants. Which section of the paper should contain this information?
q_vocab_b2_09_010.correct: La sección de metodología debe describir el proceso de recopilación de datos.
wrong: La introducción debe contener todos los datos numéricos.
Las conclusiones deben explicar cómo se hizo la investigación.
El resumen debe incluir los cuestionarios completos.
q_vocab_b2_09_010.explanation: 'La sección de metodología' แปลว่า 'the methodology section'. This part of a research paper explains the research design, data collection methods, และ analytical procedures.
q_vocab_b2_09_010.context: เขียน a research paper สำหรับ an academic journal

q_vocab_b2_10_001.question: What does 'la retórica' mean?
q_vocab_b2_10_001.explanation: 'La retórica' แปลว่า 'rhetoric', the art of effective หรือ persuasive พูด หรือ เขียน, especially the use of figures of speech และ compositional techniques.

q_vocab_b2_10_002.question: El orador presentó un ___ convincente para apoyar su posición.
q_vocab_b2_10_002.explanation: 'Argumento' แปลว่า 'argument' (in the logical sense). The senสิบce แปลว่า 'The speaker presented a convincing argument to support their position.'

q_vocab_b2_10_003.question: What does 'refutar' mean in a debate?
q_vocab_b2_10_003.explanation: 'Refutar' แปลว่า 'to refute' หรือ 'to disprove', to prove that a statement หรือ argument is incorrect by presenting counter-evidence หรือ logical reaลูกชายing.

q_vocab_b2_10_004.question: What does 'la falacia' mean?
wrong: the ร้านขายยา
q_vocab_b2_10_004.explanation: 'La falacia' แปลว่า 'fallacy', a mistaken belief หรือ a flawed argument that appears logical but is actually based on faulty reaลูกชายing.

q_vocab_b2_10_005.question: to persuade
q_vocab_b2_10_005.explanation: 'To persuade' translates to 'persuadir' ในภาษาสเปน. Don't confuse with 'perseguir' (to chase/pursue), 'percibir' (to perceive), หรือ 'permitir' (to permit).

q_vocab_b2_10_006.question: What does 'el contraargumento' mean?
q_vocab_b2_10_006.explanation: 'El contraargumento' แปลว่า 'counterargument', an argument made in opposition to another argument, used to challenge หรือ weaken the opposing position.

q_vocab_b2_10_007.question: A debater attacks their opponent's character instead of addressing the actual argument. What type of logical fallacy is this?
q_vocab_b2_10_007.explanation: 'Un ataque ad hominem' is a logical fallacy where someหนึ่ง attacks the คน making the argument rather than the argument itself. It's หนึ่ง of the most common fallacies in debates.
q_vocab_b2_10_007.context: Formal debate competition at a university

q_vocab_b2_10_008.question: What does 'la premisa' mean in logical reasoning?
q_vocab_b2_10_008.explanation: 'La premisa' แปลว่า 'premise', a statement หรือ proposition that สำหรับms the basis สำหรับ an argument หรือ from which a conclusion is drawn.

q_vocab_b2_10_009.question: el discurso persuasivo
q_vocab_b2_10_009.explanation: 'El discurso persuasivo' แปลว่า 'persuasive speech', a speech designed to convince the audience to adopt a particular viewpoint หรือ take a specific action.

q_vocab_b2_10_010.question: In a debate about environmental policy, your opponent claims that since temperatures dropped last winter, global warming is false. How would you identify this error in reasoning?
q_vocab_b2_10_010.correct: Es una falacia: usar un caso aislado para negar una tendencia general.
wrong: Es un argumento válido basado en evidencia.
Es una opinión personal sin importancia.
q_vocab_b2_10_010.explanation: This is a 'generalización apresurada' (hasty generalization) หรือ cherry-picking fallacy -- using a single data point to deny a well-documented trend. Identifying fallacies is key to effective debate.
q_vocab_b2_10_010.context: Academic debate on climate change policy

q_vocab_b2_11_001.question: What does 'la nostalgia' mean?
q_vocab_b2_11_001.correct: nostalgia / longing สำหรับ the past
q_vocab_b2_11_001.explanation: 'La nostalgia' แปลว่า 'nostalgia', a sentimental longing สำหรับ the past, ofสิบ idealized. It combines เศร้าness สำหรับ what is gหนึ่ง with อุ่น memories.

q_vocab_b2_11_002.question: What does 'la angustia' mean?

q_vocab_b2_11_002.explanation: 'La angustia' แปลว่า 'anguish' หรือ 'deep anxiety', an inสิบse feeling of emotional distress that goes beyond ordinary worry หรือ nervousness.

q_vocab_b2_11_003.question: Después de la pérdida, sintió una profunda ___ que no podía explicar.
q_vocab_b2_11_003.explanation: 'Melancolía' แปลว่า 'melancholy'. The senสิบce แปลว่า 'After the loss, they felt a deep melancholy they could not explain.' Melancholy is a persisสิบt, pensive เศร้าness.

q_vocab_b2_11_004.question: What does 'la empatía' mean?
q_vocab_b2_11_004.explanation: 'La empatía' แปลว่า 'empathy', the ability to understand และ share the feelings of another คน. It differs from 'simpatía' (sympathy/liking) และ 'apatía' (apathy).

q_vocab_b2_11_005.question: What does 'la amargura' mean?
q_vocab_b2_11_005.explanation: 'La amargura' แปลว่า 'bitterness' หรือ 'resentment', a deep feeling of hurt และ anger ofสิบ resulting from unfair treatment หรือ disappointment.

q_vocab_b2_11_006.question: to be overwhelmed (emotionally)
q_vocab_b2_11_006.explanation: 'To be overwhelmed' translates to 'estar abrumado/a'. Don't confuse with 'aburrido' (boสีแดง), 'abrigado' (warmly dressed), หรือ 'abstraído' (absent-minded).

q_vocab_b2_11_007.question: Which Spanish word describes the feeling of satisfaction from ใครบางคน else's misfortune?
q_vocab_b2_11_007.explanation: 'El regodeo' หรือ 'la satisfacción maligna' describes taking pleasure in another's misสำหรับtune (similar to the Gerผู้ชาย 'Schadenfreude'). It is the opposite of compassion.

q_vocab_b2_11_008.question: la añoranza
q_vocab_b2_11_008.explanation: 'La añoranza' แปลว่า 'longing' หรือ 'yearning', a deep emotional desire สำหรับ something absent -- a คน, place, หรือ time. Similar to nostalgia but more focused on missing something specific.

q_vocab_b2_11_009.question: A เพื่อน confides that they feel มีความสุข about a promotion but also guilty for getting it over a close colleague. Which term describes this emotional conflict?
q_vocab_b2_11_009.explanation: 'Sentimientos encontrados' แปลว่า 'mixed feelings' และ 'ambivalencia emocional' แปลว่า 'emotional ambivalence'. These terms describe the experience of having contradictory emotions simultaneously.
q_vocab_b2_11_009.context: Perลูกชายal conversation about conflicting emotions after a workplace promotion

q_vocab_b2_11_010.question: Someone describes feeling a sudden, intense wave of sadness without any apparent cause. Which nuanced Spanish expression best captures this experience?

q_vocab_b2_11_010.explanation: 'Le invadió una tristeza inexplicable' แปลว่า 'An inexplicable เศร้าness washed over them.' The verb 'invadir' (to invade) conveys the sudden, overwhelming nature of the emotion.
q_vocab_b2_11_010.context: Describing a complex emotional experience to a therapist

q_vocab_b2_12_001.question: What does 'el tribunal' mean?
q_vocab_b2_12_001.explanation: 'El tribunal' แปลว่า 'court' หรือ 'tribunal', the judicial body where legal cases are heard และ decided.

q_vocab_b2_12_002.question: El abogado presentó las pruebas ante el ___.
q_vocab_b2_12_002.explanation: 'Juez' แปลว่า 'judge'. The senสิบce แปลว่า 'The lawyer presented the evidence beสำหรับe the judge.' The judge presides over court proceedings.

q_vocab_b2_12_003.question: What does 'el contrato' mean in legal terminology?
q_vocab_b2_12_003.explanation: 'El contrato' แปลว่า 'contract', a legally binding agreement between สอง หรือ more parties that establishes obligations และ rights.

q_vocab_b2_12_004.question: What does 'el demandante' mean?
q_vocab_b2_12_004.explanation: 'El deผู้ชายdante' แปลว่า 'the plaintiff' หรือ 'claiผู้ชายt', the คน who brings a case against another in a court of law. The opposite is 'el deผู้ชายdado' (the defendant).

q_vocab_b2_12_005.question: verdict
q_vocab_b2_12_005.explanation: 'Verdict' translates to 'el veสีแดงicto' ในภาษาสเปน. It is the สำหรับmal decision made by a jury หรือ judge at the end of a trial.

q_vocab_b2_12_006.question: What does 'la demanda' mean in a legal context?
q_vocab_b2_12_006.explanation: 'La deผู้ชายda' in legal contexts แปลว่า 'lawsuit' หรือ 'legal claim'. 'Interpหนึ่งr una deผู้ชายda' แปลว่า 'to file a lawsuit'. In everyวัน language, 'deผู้ชายda' can also หมายความว่า 'deผู้ชายd'.

q_vocab_b2_12_007.question: A คน has been wrongly accused และ needs legal representation. What should they do?
q_vocab_b2_12_007.correct: Contratar a un abogado defensor para que les represente.

q_vocab_b2_12_007.explanation: 'Un abogado defensor' แปลว่า 'a defense attorney'. Everyหนึ่ง has the ถูกต้อง/ขวา to legal representation, especially when wrongly accused.
q_vocab_b2_12_007.context: Criminal justice system -- a คน needing legal help

q_vocab_b2_12_008.question: What does 'la sentencia' mean in a legal context?
wrong: the หมายถึง of a word
q_vocab_b2_12_008.explanation: 'La senสิบcia' in legal contexts แปลว่า 'senสิบce' หรือ 'court ruling', the สำหรับmal judgment handed down by a court, including any punishment.

q_vocab_b2_12_009.question: la cláusula del contrato
q_vocab_b2_12_009.explanation: 'La cláusula del contrato' แปลว่า 'the clause of the contract', a specific provision หรือ condition within a legal agreement.

q_vocab_b2_12_010.question: A tenant discovers that their landlord has violated the rental agreement. What is the most appropriate legal action?
q_vocab_b2_12_010.correct: Presentar una reclamación formal por incumplimiento de contrato.
wrong: Dejar de pagar el alquiler sin aviso.
q_vocab_b2_12_010.explanation: 'Incumplimiento de contrato' แปลว่า 'breach of contract'. Filing a สำหรับmal claim is the proper legal recourse when the other party violates agreement terms.
q_vocab_b2_12_010.context: Tenant-landlord dispute over rental agreement violations

q_vocab_b2_13_001.question: What does 'la inversión' mean in finance?

q_vocab_b2_13_001.explanation: 'La inversión' แปลว่า 'investment', the act of putting mหนึ่งy into financial assets, รถบัสinesses, หรือ projects with the expectation of generating profit.

q_vocab_b2_13_002.question: What does 'la inflación' mean?
q_vocab_b2_13_002.explanation: 'La inflación' แปลว่า 'inflation', the rate at which the general level of prices สำหรับ goods และ services rises, สีแดงucing purchasing power.

q_vocab_b2_13_003.question: El banco central decidió subir los tipos de ___.
q_vocab_b2_13_003.explanation: 'Tipos de interés' แปลว่า 'interest rates'. The senสิบce แปลว่า 'The central ธนาคาร decided to raise interest rates.' Central banks adjust rates to control inflation.

q_vocab_b2_13_004.question: What does 'la bolsa de valores' mean?
q_vocab_b2_13_004.correct: stock exchange / stock ตลาด
q_vocab_b2_13_004.explanation: 'La bolsa de valores' แปลว่า 'stock exchange' หรือ 'stock ตลาด', the marketplace where shares of publicly traded companies are bought และ sเก่า/แก่.

q_vocab_b2_13_005.question: What does 'la rentabilidad' mean?
q_vocab_b2_13_005.explanation: 'La rentabilidad' แปลว่า 'profitability' หรือ 'return on investment (ROI)', a measure of how much profit is generated relative to the amount invested.

q_vocab_b2_13_006.question: tax
q_vocab_b2_13_006.explanation: 'Tax' translates to 'el impuesto'. Don't confuse with 'impulso' (impulse), 'impacto' (impact), หรือ 'importe' (amount/total).

q_vocab_b2_13_007.question: Which Spanish term refers to the total value of all goods และ services produced by a ประเทศ in a ปี?
q_vocab_b2_13_007.explanation: 'El producto interior bruto' (PIB) แปลว่า 'gross domestic product' (GDP). It is the primary indiแมวor used to measure the health และ size of a ประเทศ's economy.

q_vocab_b2_13_008.question: la hipoteca
q_vocab_b2_13_008.explanation: 'La hipoteca' แปลว่า 'mortgage', a loan taken to purchase property where the property itself serves as collateral สำหรับ the loan.

q_vocab_b2_13_009.question: An investor wants to reduce risk by not putting all their money in หนึ่ง type of asset. What strategy should they follow?

Retirar todo el dinero del mercado.
Pedir un préstamo para invertir más.
q_vocab_b2_13_009.explanation: 'Diversifiรถยนต์ la รถยนต์tera de inversiหนึ่งs' แปลว่า 'to diversify the investment portfolio'. Spreading investments across different asset types สีแดงuces overall risk.
q_vocab_b2_13_009.context: Financial advisor meeting with a client about investment strategy

q_vocab_b2_13_010.question: A ประเทศ's currency has lost 30% of its value in หก months. What economic phenomenon is occurring?
q_vocab_b2_13_010.correct: Una devaluación de la moneda nacional.
q_vocab_b2_13_010.explanation: 'Devaluación de la mหนึ่งda' แปลว่า 'currency devaluation'. When a currency loses significant value, imports become more แพง และ the ประเทศ's purchasing power decreases.
q_vocab_b2_13_010.context: Economic ใหม่s report about currency crisis

q_vocab_b2_14_001.question: What does 'el eslogan' mean?
q_vocab_b2_14_001.explanation: 'El eslogan' (also 'el eslogan publicitario') แปลว่า 'slogan', a เตี้ย, memorable phrase used in advertising to promote a product, brand, หรือ idea.

q_vocab_b2_14_002.question: La empresa lanzó una ___ publicitaria en redes sociales.
q_vocab_b2_14_002.explanation: 'Campaña publicitaria' แปลว่า 'advertising campaign'. The senสิบce แปลว่า 'The company launched an advertising campaign on social media.' Don't confuse 'campaña' (campaign) with 'campana' (bell).

q_vocab_b2_14_003.question: What does 'el público objetivo' mean in marketing?
q_vocab_b2_14_003.explanation: 'El público objetivo' แปลว่า 'target audience', the specific group of consumers that a marketing campaign is designed to reach และ influence.

q_vocab_b2_14_004.question: What does 'la marca' mean in advertising?
q_vocab_b2_14_004.explanation: 'La marca' แปลว่า 'brand', the identifying name, symbol, หรือ design that distinguishes a product หรือ company from competitors.

q_vocab_b2_14_005.question: commercial / advertisement
q_vocab_b2_14_005.explanation: 'Commercial' หรือ 'advertisement' translates to 'el anuncio publicitario' (หรือ simply 'el anuncio'). It refers to a paid message in media to promote a product หรือ service.

q_vocab_b2_14_006.question: What does 'el patrocinador' mean?
q_vocab_b2_14_006.explanation: 'El patrocinador' แปลว่า 'sponsor', a คน หรือ organization that provides financial support สำหรับ an event, activity, หรือ media conสิบt, usually in exchange สำหรับ advertising.

q_vocab_b2_14_007.question: A marketing team wants to evaluate whether their recent ad campaign was successful. What metric should they analyze?
q_vocab_b2_14_007.correct: El retorno de la inversión publicitaria (ROI).
wrong: El número de empleados en la empresa.
El color del logotipo de la marca.
q_vocab_b2_14_007.explanation: 'El retorno de la inversión publicitaria' แปลว่า 'return on advertising investment'. ROI measures the revenue generated relative to the cost of the campaign to assess its effectiveness.
q_vocab_b2_14_007.context: Marketing ชาm quarterly perสำหรับผู้ชายce review

q_vocab_b2_14_008.question: What does 'la difusión mediática' mean?
q_vocab_b2_14_008.explanation: 'La difusión mediática' แปลว่า 'media coverage' หรือ 'media dissemination', the exสิบt to which inสำหรับmation is spread through various media channels.

q_vocab_b2_14_009.question: el consumidor
q_vocab_b2_14_009.explanation: 'El consumidor' แปลว่า 'consumer', a คน who purchases และ uses goods หรือ services. Understanding consumer behavior is central to advertising และ marketing.

q_vocab_b2_14_010.question: A brand discovers that negative reviews about their product are going viral on social media. What should their communiแมวions ชาm do first?
q_vocab_b2_14_010.correct: Emitir un comunicado oficial abordando las quejas de los consumidores.
wrong: Eliminar todos los comentarios negativos sin responder.
Atacar públicamente a los clientes insatisfechos.
q_vocab_b2_14_010.explanation: 'Emitir un comunicado oficial' แปลว่า 'to issue an official statement'. Addressing consumer complaints transparently is essential สำหรับ crisis ผู้ชายagement และ protecting brand reputation.
q_vocab_b2_14_010.context: Brand reputation crisis ผู้ชายagement on social media
